question: Which opening arrangement mechanisms add character beyond the studied lead PWM, and is a source-backed percussion role feasible without losing the current bass or hook?

filterAndVolume: Renderer snapshots after startup retain D41708 and D4180F throughout 60s: external-input route bit only, no oscillator filter route, constant master volume. Renderer sampling is not an ordered bus-write census.

recommendedBoundedTest: Existing unchanged KICKFALL on currently idle harmony voice for arranged beats64–96, triggered only by source MIDI36 onsets, with explicit duration adaptation to0.18s capped at next source kick/window end. Keep immediate bass and lead intact. This tests a percussion accent/body role, not recovered full drums or a new independent onset rhythm.

kickOpportunity.scope: Source rational timing and planned cap arithmetic; native rounding, TEST/body and actual program interruption require the executed candidate schedule and writes.

musicalInference: The reference supplies contrasting percussion programs, separate bass/lead envelope identities, staged entrances and phrase space. These explain available arrangement mechanisms, not why the listener prefers the complete reference. No new musical-acceptance judgment is made.
rejectedShortcut: BASS02 inserts a transient at each bass onset and delays its pitched body, so it cannot preserve independent drum/bass envelopes or reproduce the reference percussion distribution. Prior little/no perceived difference and rejected Bach percussion remain scoped evidence, not a universal prohibition.
